messages:
leah: ACME procurement sent a checklist — they need our SOC 2 cert, ISO summary, and a signed pen-test attestation for the upcoming POC. timeline: they want everything within 7 business days. who can own collating artifacts?

chris-sales: quick Q on scope — is the POC going to run in a shared hosted environment or do they want Dedicated/isolated infra? that affects what we can include in the evidence package and timeline.

leah: @chris-sales they asked for evidence showing separation for data used in the POC. leaning toward dedicated for the demo, but we need pricing clarity if Dedicated is required.

amanda: I can pull the SOC 2 report and ISO overview. do we have a current pen-test letter template that legal can sign?

security-bot: :page_with_curl: Assurances checklist (auto): [SOC2 report v2025-09], [ISO 27001 certificate summary], [Pen-test attestation template], [Network diagram (redacted)], [KMS key flow doc]. Confirm which environment used and whether customer data will be in the POC.

tom: I have a blank pen-test attestation we usually sign for POCs. attaching the template here: 
```
To whom it may concern,\nThis letter attests that Redwood Inference engaged an independent penetration testing firm (Firm Name) on (date) and no critical findings related to externally exposed inference endpoints were identified. Test scope: hosted inference endpoints used for POC.\nSincerely,\nRedwood Security
```

leah: perfect. two follow-ups: (1) chris, can you confirm customer's acceptance of a hosted-but-isolated tenancy vs full Dedicated? that will change pricing ask. (2) amanda, please redact any customer-sensitive IP from the network diagram before sharing.

chris-sales: just messaged their procurement lead — they prefer Dedicated but will accept a documented isolation plan if pricing for Dedicated is too high. asked for ballpark commit and lead time. will share reply here.

amanda: noted on redaction. can take SOC2/ISO artifacts from /shared/assurance/soc2-2025 and make a trimmed package. how should we deliver: encrypted zip via secure link or SFTP?

leah: secure link is fine (customer requested a portal link). use one-time expiring link and include a short manifest. include the pen-test attestation as a signed PDF.

security-bot: :lock: Reminder: before sharing, we need confirmation that no customer PII is included. run quick scan: `scripts/assurance/scan_for_pii --path ./package` and attach the scan report.

amanda: will run the scan and attach report. ETA for package: EOD Tue if chris confirms environment this afternoon.

chris-sales: update from ACME: they'd like Dedicated for the production rollout but will accept a POC in hosted-isolated tenancy for now. they want pricing for a 3-month Dedicated commitment as part of the RFP.

leah: good — action items:
- amanda: assemble SOC2/ISO + pen-test attestation, run PII scan, create expiring link (EOD Tue)
- tom/security: sign pen-test attestation PDF and approve manifest (tom)
- chris-sales: add Dedicated 3-month ballpark to the RFP response and confirm whether they need an NDA addendum for audit artifacts

amanda: ack, will start now and post link when ready.

tom: I'll add my signature to the attestation and drop PDF to the link once amanda shares.

leah: thanks everyone — if anything blocks, ping me. I’ll also loop in legal if ACME needs the signed attestation on letterhead or with a notary. :thumbsup:

chris-sales: will ask about notary and let you know.

leah: closing note — keep the evidence package minimal and redacted; procurement mostly cares about high-level controls and an official pen-test attestation. we can provide architecture diagrams later for Dedicated evaluation.

security-bot: :white_check_mark: Logged: assurance-package request for ACME (due 7 business days). Ticket #ASSURE-4872.
